notes.title: v1.0.5 - Skip Option
notes.content:
Another small update, but a much needed one. You can now skip the fate wheel animation by a single click.

Thank you all for the feedback and bug reports!

If you want to show your support to the game and ShotX, don't forget that one of the best ways to do so can be simply done by leaving a review.

v1.0.5

[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Keep The Gold
notes.content:
Time for another update! You can now keep 15% of your lost gold after death and to make collecting crystals a bit easier - mobs now have a 6% chance of dropping crystals.

Thank you everyone for the feedback and bug reports!

If you want to show your support to the game and ShotX, don't forget that one of the best ways to do so can be simply done by leaving a review.

v1.0.3
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing dash to stop working if remapped to a different key
[*] Mobs now have a chance of dropping crystals
[*] Added a limit to max amount of crystals
[*] You can now keep 15% of your gold when you die
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1 - New type of chests
notes.content:
The first update is officially out now. Introducing a new way to spend all your unused keys - rock chests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37904060/245e95bcb15511ee2597cc4da8781631a1e10676.png[/img]

Think of it as a chest within a chest. First you use your keys to break open the rock chest and in it you'll find one of the 4 available chests that can also be found in the normal levels.

Also, once again be sure to share your feedback and impressions on our forums. And finally, If you want to show your support to the game and ShotX, don't forget that one of the best ways to do so can be simply done by leaving a review.

v1.0.1
[list]
[*] Fixed area 3 traps not working
[*] More ways to use keys - added rock chests
[*] Added sound and visual feedback for player damage
[*] Added an option to turn off background lighting, which could be distracting for some
[*] Added an option to turn on directional dash
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeons of Clay - Out Now!
notes.content:
We've got some good news.

[h2]Dungeons of Clay is out now![/h2]

It was originally planned to launch in Early Access, but the plans have changed and for the good. All the final content was done including 999,999 (that's right 999,999!) procedurally generated endings. Just to be clear that doesn't mean there won't be any future content updates, but the game is now complete and ready to be experienced from start to finish.

So, grab your favorite drink, snacks and get ready to jump into the world of clay.

I hope you all have fun playing Dungeons of Clay.

Also, be sure to share your feedback and impressions on our forums. And finally, If you want to show your support to the game and ShotX, don't forget that one of the best ways to do so can be simply done by leaving a review.

Have fun! 🤍
